name: royal-biriyani-fullstack
description: Royal Biriyani & Fast Food - Fullstack Next.js, Node.js, Express & MongoDB Application

scripts.start: concurrently -n "BACKEND,FRONTEND" -c "bgBlue.bold,bgMagenta.bold" "cd backend && npm start" "cd frontend && npm start"
scripts.install:all: npm install && cd backend && npm install && cd ../frontend && npm install
scripts.clean:ports: powershell -Command "try { Get-NetTCPConnection -LocalPort 3000, 5000 -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue | ForEach-Object { Stop-Process -Id $_.OwningProcess -Force -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue } } catch {}; exit 0"

author: Royal Biriyani
